text:
Clare: Heads-up  candidate accepted but asked to move start earlier and requested a $7k sign-on to cover notice buyout. Our L4 sign-on cap is $6k. Can we route an exception fast?

Rosa (Recruiter): Offer signed at 08:30. Candidate can start 2025-09-08 if we cover the buyout; otherwise start delayed to 10/01. Manager prefers earlier to avoid sprint gap.

Ben (Hiring Manager): Justification: candidate critical to feature launch; short notice gap causes handoff risk and blocking work. Requesting one-off $7k sign-on and permission to pay 100% on first paycheck.

Clare: Two asks: 1) approve $1k over band cap as one-time sign-on, 2) payroll confirm paying full sign-on on first run and tax handling.

Elliot: Payroll ok to pay full on first paycheck; withholding normal. Any exception >$10k would need Comp Committee + Finance but this is within cash thresholds. Still need hiring manager attestation and signed DocuSign addendum for audit.

Rosa (Recruiter): Pasting comp stub:
``
Base: $138,000
Level: L4
Band cap sign-on: $6,000
Requested sign-on: $7,000
Payment: 100% first paycheck
Justification: notice buyout to enable 9/8 start for launch
``

Clare: I'll upload comp-exception short form and attach signed offer; routing to @comp-committee for one-off acknowledgment and audit. Recommend marking as "one-off - notice buyout" to avoid policy drift.

Comp Committee: Acknowledged. We'll fast-track review and post decision in-thread. Please attach notice documentation if available.

Rosa (Recruiter): Candidate can provide notice invoice; DocuSign awaiting addendum. Will update ticket HR-1107.

Clare: Thanks all. If committee signs off today, we'll confirm with candidate and finalize start. :thumbsup:
